records.jp: ねぇ香織、放課後時間ある？
records.en_original: Hey, Kaori, are you free this afternoon?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Kaori, are you free after school today?
records.en: Hey, Kaori, are you free this afternoon?

records.jp: ……陸上部には戻んないよ。<CR>何度も言ってんじゃん
records.en_original: ...How many times do I have to tell you? I'm not going to track and field.
records.en_auxiliary: ...How many times do I have to tell you? I'm not going to track and field.
records.en: ...How many times do I have to tell you? I'm not going to track and field.

records.jp: そう言わないで。<CR>走らなくてもいいからさ
records.en_original: Oh, don't be like that. You don't even have to run!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, don't be like that. You don't even have to run!
records.en: Oh, don't be like that. You don't even have to run!

records.jp: 走らないのに行ってどーすんの
records.en_original: If I'm not going to run, why would I go in the first place?
records.en_auxiliary: If I'm not going to run, why would I go in the first place?
records.en: If I'm not going to run, why would I go in the first place?

records.jp: 梨佳はあたしにタイム計ったり、ドリンク作りだけさせる気？
records.en_original: What, do you want me to be your watergirl and time your runs for you?
records.en_auxiliary: What, do you want me to be your watergirl and time your runs for you?
records.en: What, do you want me to be your watergirl and time your runs for you?

records.jp: え、そういうわけじゃ……
records.en_original: Wait, I didn't mean it that way...
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, I didn't mean it that way...
records.en: Wait, I didn't mean it that way...

records.jp: あー、もうパスパス。<CR>行っても邪魔なだけだって
records.en_original: Ugh, yeah, hard pass. I'd only be in the way if I joined you anyway.
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh, yeah, hard pass. I'd only be in the way if I joined you anyway.
records.en: Ugh, yeah, hard pass. I'd only be in the way if I joined you anyway.

records.jp: それに今は他にやりたいことあんの
records.en_original: Besides, I've got other things to do.
records.en_auxiliary: Besides, I've got other things to do.
records.en: Besides, I've got other things to do.

records.jp: やりたいこと？　そうなの？<CR>それって何？
records.en_original: Do you? Really? Like what?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you? Really? Like what?
records.en: Do you? Really? Like what?

records.jp: ゲーム
records.en_original: Games.
records.en_auxiliary: Games.
records.en: Games.

records.jp: えっ、またスマホ？<CR>香織、そればっかじゃん……
records.en_original: On your smartphone? Kaori, that's all you ever do anymore...
records.en_auxiliary: On your smartphone? Kaori, that's all you ever do anymore...
records.en: On your smartphone? Kaori, that's all you ever do anymore...

records.jp: もういいじゃん、あたしのことなんだから。<CR>ほっといてよ……
records.en_original: Look, it's my life, I can do what I want with it. Just stop bothering me.
records.en_auxiliary: Look, it's my life—I can do what I want with it. Just stop bothering me.
records.en: Look, it's my life, I can do what I want with it. Just stop bothering me.

records.jp: ……なんだか、ケンカしてるみたい
records.en_original: ...Are those two having a fight?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Are those two having a fight?
records.en: ...Are those two having a fight?

records.jp: うーん、あの二人はいつもあんな感じだよ
records.en_original: Oh, they're like that most of the time.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, they're like that most of the time.
records.en: Oh, they're like that most of the time.

records.jp: りかちんはかおりんに<CR>陸上部に戻ってほしいんだね
records.en_original: Rikachin wants Kaorin to get back into track and field.
records.en_auxiliary: Rikachin wants Kaorin to get back into track and field.
records.en: Rika-chin wants Kaorin to get back into track and field.

records.jp: りかちん？　かおりん？
records.en_original: Rikachin? Kaorin?
records.en_auxiliary: Rikachin? Kaorin?
records.en: Rika-chin? Kaorin?

records.jp: 芳村梨佳ちゃんと三井香織ちゃん
records.en_original: Rika Yoshimura and Kaori Mitsui.
records.en_auxiliary: Rika Yoshimura and Kaori Mitsui.
records.en: Yoshimura Rika-chan and Mitsui Kaori-chan.

records.jp: 二人とも同じ中学の陸上部出身なの。<CR>でも、香織ちゃんは高校では陸上部に入ってないみたい
records.en_original: They were track and field buddies in middle school, but Kaori dropped it once they entered high school.
records.en_auxiliary: They were track and field buddies in middle school, but Kaori dropped it once they entered high school.
records.en: They were track and field buddies in middle school, but Kaori-chan dropped it once they entered high school.

records.jp: ねえ、香織は私よりも速いのに<CR>どうして辞めちゃったの！？　もったいないよ
records.en_original: Why did you quit, anyway? You were faster than me! It just feels like such a waste!
records.en_auxiliary: Why did you quit, anyway? You were faster than me! It just feels like such a waste!
records.en: Why did you quit, anyway? You were faster than me! It just feels like such a waste!

records.jp: 速いって言っても、たかが知れてるじゃん。<CR>頑張ったって、インターハイに出られるとも思えないし
records.en_original: Sure, you say I'm fast, but I wouldn't make it to the interhigh meet no matter how much training I did.
records.en_auxiliary: Sure, you say I'm fast, but I wouldn't make it to nationals no matter how much training I did.
records.en: Sure, you say I'm fast, but I wouldn't make it to the interhigh meet no matter how much training I did.

records.jp: あたしの中で陸上は終わってんの
records.en_original: As far as I'm concerned, I'm done.
records.en_auxiliary: As far as I'm concerned, I'm done.
records.en: As far as I'm concerned, I'm done.

records.jp: で、でもインターハイが、結果だけがすべてじゃないでしょ！<CR>他にも大切なことがあるはずだよ
records.en_original: But winning the interhigh isn't everything! Track's so much more than that!
records.en_auxiliary: But winning nationals isn't everything! Track's so much more than that!
records.en: But winning the interhigh isn't everything! Track's so much more than that!

records.jp: みんなでバトンをつないでいく感動とか、そういうのだって……
records.en_original: It's the passion you feel when passing the baton, the high of running past your limits, things like that!
records.en_auxiliary: It's the passion you feel when passing the baton, the high of running past your limits, things like that!
records.en: It's the passion you feel when passing the baton, the high of running past your limits, things like that!

records.jp: ……それは梨佳、あんたの考え方だって
records.en_original: ...Maybe you think so, Rika.
records.en_auxiliary: ...That's just your way of thinking, Rika.
records.en: ...Maybe you think so, Rika.

records.jp: それは、そうかもだけど……でも……
records.en_original: Well, I can only speak for myself...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I can only speak for myself...
records.en: Well, I can only speak for myself...

records.jp: ……あ、ほら！<CR>ミキ先輩もきっと会いたがってるよ！
records.en_original: ...Oh, right! Your favorite upperclassman wanted to see you, too!
records.en_auxiliary: ...Oh, right! Miki wanted to see you, too!
records.en: ...Oh, right!<CR>I'm sure Miki-senpai wants to see you too!

records.jp: ……それは
records.en_original: ...Did she?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Did she?
records.en: ...Did she?

records.jp: 会いたいでしょ、ミキ先輩
records.en_original: Don't you want to see Miki again?
records.en_auxiliary: Don't you want to see Miki again?
records.en: Don't you want to see Miki-senpai again?

records.jp: ……うん、まあ
records.en_original: Well, sure.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, sure.
records.en: Well, sure.

records.jp: 私たちが陸上を始めたきっかけだもんね！<CR>最近、また１００メートルの記録を更新したんだよ！
records.en_original: Of course you do, she's the reason we started track in the first place! Just improved her time on the 100-meter, too!
records.en_auxiliary: Of course you do, she's the reason we started track in the first place! She just improved her time on the 100-meter, too!
records.en: Of course you do, she's the reason we started track in the first place! Just improved her time on the 100-meter, too!

records.jp: だから、よかったら香織も応援に――
records.en_original: That's why you should come and cheer--
records.en_auxiliary: That's why you should come and cheer—
records.en: That's why you should come and cheer--

records.jp: ……ごめん。やっぱパス
records.en_original: No thanks. I'll pass.
records.en_auxiliary: No thanks. I'll pass.
records.en: No thanks. I'll pass.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 先輩が頑張ってるならそれでいいよ。<CR>またなんかあったら話聞かせてよね
records.en_original: I'm just glad to know she's still giving it her all. Let me know if she does anything else, okay?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm just glad to know she's still giving it her all. Let me know if she does anything else, okay?
records.en: I'm just glad to know she's still giving it her all. Let me know if she does anything else, okay?

records.jp: じゃあね
records.en_original: Later.
records.en_auxiliary: Later.
records.en: Later.

records.jp: 香織！？<CR>ちょ、ちょっと！
records.en_original: Kaori!? Wait up!
records.en_auxiliary: Kaori?! Hold on!
records.en: Kaori!? Wait up!

records.jp: （二人とも、先輩に憧れて陸上を始めたんだ……）
records.en_original: (So, they both got into track because they had someone to look up to...)
records.en_auxiliary: (So they both got into track because they had someone they looked up to...)
records.en: (So, they both got into track because they had someone to look up to...)

records.jp: （私も、誰かに憧れてる時期があったなぁ）
records.en_original: (I can relate.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I can relate.)
records.en: (I can relate.)
